initialize.body:
event: message
data: {"result":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{"tools":{"listChanged":true},"resources":{"listChanged":true}},"serverInfo":{"name":"mcp-typescript server on vercel","version":"0.1.0"},"instructions":"Internet Court — the trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce and delegated agent authority.

This MCP server helps an agent or its user install and use the Internet Court skill. Internet
Court is not a single file: it is a whole structure of skills (a master router plus connector
and vendored protocol skills) published at https://github.com/internet-court/internet-court-skill.

When a user asks to install, load, add, or introduce Internet Court, call "how_to_install" for
setup steps, and call "get_internet_court_skill" to fetch the latest skill content (the master
SKILL.md by default, or any sub-skill by path) so you can act on it immediately.

Internet Court turns a natural-language mandate into a runnable workflow with bounded
permissions (ERC-7710/7715), execution, evidence, GenLayer Intelligent Contract supervision,
revocation, x402 payments, escrow, and dispute resolution."},"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1}
